# Implementation Plan: Local Server Foundation (Phase 0)

**Branch**: `000-local-server-foundation` (planning performed from `main` with explicit override) | **Date**: 2026-05-30 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/000-local-server-foundation/spec.md`

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit.plan`. See `.specify/templates/plan-template.md` for the source template.

## Summary

Deliver the foundational Balsm self-hosted server: cross-platform OS-native installer (Windows `.msi`, macOS `.dmg`, Linux `.deb`), system-service registration, HTTPS admin panel served on a configurable non-privileged port (default `:8443`) with a first-run wizard, workspace/entity/branch CRUD (single workspace, soft-delete only), mDNS discovery in Network/Public modes, SQLite migrations applied at startup, on-demand and scheduled backups via the SQLite online backup API with configurable retention and an atomic in-process restore, append-only audit logging with 2-year retention and JSONL archive on prune, a security baseline (TLS 1.2+, Argon2id, rate-limit + 15-minute lockout, 30-minute idle expiry), single-admin enforcement, password recovery (CLI + one-time recovery code), Arabic/English RTL admin UI, and a system-tray / CLI status surface.

Technical approach: extend the existing `Balsm-API-DotNet` modular-monolith (`src/Modules/{Identity,Entity}` already present at ~70% completion) with new modules / cross-cutting services for `Backup`, `AuditLog`, `Mdns`, `Lifecycle` (migration gate + restore orchestration), plus the React + Vite admin UI shell for the first-run wizard and admin pages. The `Balsm.Supervisor` companion process handles system-tray/menu-bar surface and CLI subcommands (`status`, `backup`, `db restore`, `admin reset-password`). Tunnel mode (Public) integrates with the existing `tunnel-registry` workspace as a pluggable provider.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: .NET 10.0 (C#) for backend; TypeScript 5.8 + React 19 for admin UI; Bash / PowerShell for installer hooks
**Primary Dependencies**: ASP.NET Core 10, Entity Framework Core 10.0.5 (SQLite provider with `Microsoft.Data.Sqlite` online backup API), `Tmds.MDns` or `Zeroconf` for mDNS, `Konscious.Security.Cryptography.Argon2` (or libsodium binding) for password hashing, FluentValidation, Serilog (structured logging), Vite + React + React Router 7 admin SPA
**Storage**: SQLite (`balsm.db`) embedded; backups + audit JSONL archives under configurable backup directory (default `<install-dir>/backups/`)
**Testing**: xUnit + FluentAssertions for backend; integration tests use `Testcontainers`-style in-process SQLite (no mocked DB layer per Constitution VI); React admin UI uses Vitest + React Testing Library; Playwright for end-to-end first-run wizard flow
**Target Platform**: Windows 10+ (`.msi`, Windows Service), macOS 12+ (`.dmg`, `launchd` LaunchDaemon), Ubuntu 20.04 LTS+ equivalent Linux (`.deb`, `systemd`). Minimum hardware: 4 GB RAM, dual-core CPU, 20 GB free disk.
**Project Type**: Desktop server + admin web SPA (existing modular monolith repo) + Flutter clients (separate repos; consume server contracts only — not in scope for Phase 0 server delivery)
**Performance Goals**: Server ready in ≤10 s post-boot (SC-002); 50 concurrent SQLite read connections at ≥10 rps each for ≥60 s with p95 <100 ms read latency on minimum-spec (SC-006); backup ≤30 s for 1 GB DB (FR-011); mDNS visibility ≤5 s post-ready (FR-008)
**Constraints**: Offline-capable, single-server install, single workspace, single admin (Phase 0), no PHI, no privileged port binding, no `EnsureCreated` in production, no hard deletes on domain tables, HTTPS only with self-signed cert (cloud auth deferred to Phase 1+)
**Scale/Scope**: 1 workspace × 1 entity × 1..N branches × 1 admin per server install; audit log up to ~10 M rows/year worst-case sustainable on SQLite WAL; backup directory disk budget ≥ retention_count × DB size

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

Mapping spec ↔ constitution principles:

| Principle | Status | Evidence / Notes |
|-----------|--------|------------------|
| I. Patient Safety First | N/A | No clinical data at Phase 0; FR-015/016 cover soft-delete + audit baseline that downstream clinical phases will inherit |
| II. Security & Privacy by Design | PASS | FR-017 (TLS 1.2+, Argon2id, rate-limit) + FR-018a (recovery) + FR-016 (audit on every write/auth-state-change). 15-min lockout duration to be set in research (constitution §II requires 15 min) |
| III. Regulatory Compliance | PASS | Spec Certification Compliance table: FHIR/LOINC/SNOMED/ICD-10/RxNorm N/A at this phase; PDPL covered by FR-016a JSONL data-export pipeline |
| IV. Modular Monolith with DDD | PASS | New cross-cutting services (`Backup`, `AuditLog`, `Mdns`, `Lifecycle`) live in `src/Modules/Platform` (new) and `src/Balsm.Infrastructure` — no cross-module table access; Entity module retains its own schema |
| V. Offline-First, Cloud-Enhanced | PASS | Standalone is default; Network + Public modes opt-in; HTTPS on non-localhost enforced; mDNS discovery present (FR-008); multi-server client connectivity is client-side (out of scope here) |
| VI. Test-First Discipline | PASS | Integration tests over real in-process SQLite per constitution §VI (no DB mocks); first-run wizard and recovery flows require 100% test coverage (auth endpoints) |
| VII. Performance as a Feature | PASS | SC-002, SC-006 quantified; `AsNoTracking()` mandated in repo standards; `Include` for relations; pagination at DB; async I/O end-to-end with `CancellationToken` propagation |
| VIII. Multi-Platform Consistency | **DEVIATION** | Spec FR-001 ships `.msi` / `.dmg` / `.deb` only (AppImage dropped). Constitution §VIII lists `.deb + .AppImage`. See Complexity Tracking for justification. Admin UI is React + Vite (not Flutter) — admin UI explicitly excluded from "four Flutter apps" scope; React choice predates this phase and is already implemented |
| IX. Ubiquitous Language | PASS | Spec uses "entity" / "workspace" / "branch" canonical terms; .NET command/query naming standard (`CreateEntityCommand`, `GetEntityByIdQuery`) applies to new modules |
| X. AI Governance | N/A | No AI features at Phase 0 |
| XI. Certifications & Standards Compliance | PASS | Spec Certification Compliance section identifies DPG + PDPL obligations; design satisfies code-level rules (no PHI, FHIR resources, or medical codes introduced this phase) |

**Certification compliance gate** *(required if feature touches clinical data, FHIR, lab, medications, or patient records)*:

- [x] `/metadata` CapabilityStatement update required? — **No** (no FHIR resources introduced at this phase)
- [x] New personal data collected? Consent mechanism planned? — **Yes** (admin email, entity contact details); consent banner displayed in first-run wizard with PDPL notice and lawful-basis statement
- [x] All new data exportable as FHIR Bundle on patient request? — **N/A** (no patient data); admin + entity export available as JSON via PDPL data-subject-access endpoint (deferred handler — placeholder route reserved; full implementation tracked as TODO under FR-016a archive surface)

**Gate result**: PASS with one documented deviation (installer matrix). See Complexity Tracking.

**Structure Decision**: Existing `Balsm-API-DotNet` modular monolith (Option 2 — Web application, with `admin-ui` as the SPA frontend) is the target. New work lives in (a) two existing modules (`Identity`, `Entity`) and (b) new cross-cutting infra namespaces inside `Balsm.Infrastructure` plus a new `Endpoints/` group under `Balsm.API`. The `Balsm.Supervisor` companion process handles tray + CLI surface (cross-platform). Packaging gets per-OS dirs that register the correct service manager. No new bounded contexts are created — the 13 contexts from Constitution §IV are preserved; Phase 0 work is platform/foundation rather than domain.

## Complexity Tracking

> Filled because Constitution Check found one deviation.

| Violation | Why Needed | Simpler Alternative Rejected Because |
|-----------|------------|-------------------------------------|
| FR-001 ships only `.deb` for Linux (drops `.AppImage` listed in Constitution §VIII) | FR-002 mandates registration as a `systemd` unit. AppImage is a portable image format that does not install/register a system service — making both deliverables impossible to satisfy FR-002 simultaneously | Shipping both formats would either (a) require AppImage to no-op its service registration (violates FR-002) or (b) add a separate "AppImage-only" service-bootstrap flow doubling install / support surface for a format we cannot guarantee starts at boot. A future phase MAY revisit a portable mode that explicitly opts out of FR-002 |
| Admin UI is React + Vite (not Flutter) — Constitution §VIII names "four Flutter apps" | Existing admin UI is a long-lived browser-based control panel for the server itself — not a patient or staff Flutter app. Web SPA is the right tech for in-browser admin served by the server | Reimplementing the existing partially-shipped admin UI in Flutter Web would duplicate work already in `admin-ui/` and add no end-user benefit; constitution scope of "four Flutter apps" addresses Balsm / Balsm Pro / Balsm Connect, not the server-resident admin UI |
